picks.headline: Framework Desktop packs Ryzen AI Max, up to 192GB of RAM, and local AI into a mini PC
picks.excerpt: Framework's new Desktop pairs a Ryzen AI Max+ Pro 495 with up to 192GB of unified memory so creators can run frontier-class models like DeepSeek-V4-Flash entirely on a single local box.
picks.rationale: Highest actionability: a shipping desk-side box that lets a studio run frontier-class models locally, changing what design teams can do without sending work to the cloud.

picks.headline: Voicepilled vibe coders are drooling over this touchpad you control with your tongue
picks.excerpt: Augmental's MouthPad tongue-controlled trackpad and whisper-detecting mic were built as accessibility devices, but AI-first coders are adopting them as a hands-free input layer for agent workflows.
picks.rationale: Genuinely new input paradigm: an accessibility device repurposed as the hands-free control surface for agentic work, the freshest interaction-design signal in the pool.

picks.headline: macOS 27 beta reveals hidden Siri 'Voice Pad' interface
picks.excerpt: A hidden macOS 27 interface lets you pick Siri's voice from an interactive spatial-audio grid of up to 13 American English voices that responds as the cursor moves.
picks.rationale: A rare look at how Apple designs a voice-selection UI as a spatial, cursor-responsive grid - directly instructive for anyone designing AI voice interfaces.

picks.headline: Ultrahuman overhauls its app, brings all of its analysis on-device
picks.excerpt: Ultrahuman's redesigned Emerald app simplifies the interface and moves all health analysis onto the ring itself, so its AI insights keep working with no internet connection.
picks.rationale: AI changes what the device does: moving the whole analysis layer onto the ring makes insights work offline, plus a full app redesign built around that shift.

picks.headline: Google expands Gemini Live to some of its oldest smart speakers and displays
picks.excerpt: Google is rolling out Gemini Live to first-generation Google Home Mini and Nest Hub hardware, letting years-old speakers hold free-form conversational sessions instead of one-shot commands.
picks.rationale: A shipping rollout that turns years-old hardware into a free-form conversational device - the clearest case of AI changing what an existing product actually is.
